title: liyupi/ai-guide

title: ai-boost/awesome-prompts
description: Curated prompts, frameworks and papers for LLMs and agents, with an engineering bias. Prompt engineering, context engineering, agent harnesses, red teaming.

title: ModelEngine-Group/nexent
description: Nexent is a zero-code platform for auto-generating production-grade AI agents using Harness Engineering principles — unified tools, skills, memory, and orchestration with built-in constraints, feedback loops, and control planes.

title: ai-boost/awesome-harness-engineering
description: Awesome list for AI agent harness engineering: tools, patterns, evals, memory, MCP, permissions, observability, and orchestration.

title: AgnesAI-Labs/agnes-harness
description: Agnes Harness: A pluggable agent harness for Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE). Built for trust. Made for the real world.

title: bytedance/deer-flow
description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.

title: ruvnet/ruflo
description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated

title: alibaba/open-code-review
description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

title: nanocoai/nanoclaw
description: Your own always-on AI assistant: self-hosted, open source, lightweight. Each agent runs in its own container on your machine, on the harness you choose (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode). Talk to it from Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord and more.

title: FlorianBruniaux/claude-code-ultimate-guide
description: The most comprehensive Claude Code guide: agentic workflows, hooks, skills, MCP servers, quizzes, and production-ready templates. 430K+ lines.

title: Mistgate/mistgate
description: Beta. Self-hosted VPN panel for family, friends or a small team: Hysteria2, VLESS REALITY, AmneziaWG and TrustTunnel, one link per person. Add servers from the browser over SSH; one TCP 443 for several protocols, decoy sites from a template, health checks, Telegram alerts, MCP for AI agents. Two Go binaries, SQLite, no Docker.

title: sparesparrow/mcp-prompts
description: Model Context Protocol server for managing, storing, and providing prompts and prompt templates for LLM interactions.

title: useapi/google-flow-api
description: Node.js and Python examples for the third-party Google Flow API by useapi.net: Veo 3.1, Omni 1.2 and Omni 1.1 Flash video with extend, Nano Banana Pro, 2.1 and 2 Lite images, Google Flow Agent chat (live demo app), n8n templates and a hosted MCP server, on your Google AI subscription. No Google Cloud project or Gemini API key.
